name: calibre-mcp
description: Calibre ebook library for Claude: the calibre-mcp server (search, semantic search, content extraction, metadata curation — 17 tools) plus companion skills (guided setup, usage guide, calibre-distill, calibre-distill-topic).

server_url.title: Calibre Content Server URL
server_url.description: Where the Calibre Content Server listens (Calibre → Connect/share → Start Content server).

library.title: Library
library.description: Library display name or ID. Leave empty to auto-detect the server's default library.

enable_write.title: Enable write tools
enable_write.description: Master write gate. Off = read-only (search/read still work). On = metadata updates, add/remove/merge books; every write is still preview-first.

add_roots.title: Add-book root folder
add_roots.description: Folder calibre_add_book may import files from. Leave empty for the default (~/Documents and ~/Downloads).
